summary: The diff implements both REQ-29 and REQ-30 substantially. REQ-29 is addressed via a fixed VolunteerPage with useRegisterVolunteer, inline success/error messages, form reset on success, and React Query cache invalidation that flows through to the dashboard volunteer count. REQ-30 is addressed via ResourceMapPage with volunteer markers using useGetVolunteers, a CITY_COORDS lookup table for geocoding, visually distinct volunteer markers, popup content showing name/city/skills/availability, a sidebar volunteer list as fallback, and a legend distinguishing hospitals from volunteers. Most acceptance criteria appear met; one minor AC for REQ-29 (form data preserved on failure) may be partially met since the form is only reset on success, but error path preservation needs confirmation from the truncated diff.
